{{Top|leg}}
A '''Lightning jack''' was a type of predatory creature known to inhabit the [[Stratos Distribution/Legends|Stratos Distribution]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. They coexisted with the native [[Lugubraa]] and [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]-wide [[stillsail]]s.
